cohort: 1013 women with a vertex singleton gestation and 1 prior low-transverse cesarean section
finding: A pre-labor model using variables such as gestational age and previous cesarean delivery to predict successful VBAC is feasible and may help choose mode of birth and contribute to a reduction in cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: This study developed a model to predict successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) to help inform mode of birth choices.
